text:
Devon: Heads-up — integrating the new rack group into dedicated pools. Need a quick status check on procurement + facilities power approval. Targeting Q3 turn-up window, any blockers?

Anya: Procurement update: boards and NVMe sleds are in transit, ETA Fri 10/11. PO#45821. Still waiting on facilities sign-off (ticket FAC-229) for power/circuit mapping.

Liam: Quick ask — can someone drop the rack layout + VLAN zoning? I need to build and validate the runtime image for the H100 nodes. Kernel 6.1 + patched driver is required for the perf tests.

Kate: @Anya can you confirm the expected power-on timeline? SRE needs a concrete window to schedule canaries and paging rotation. Prefer Tue night if possible.

Anya: FAC ticket updated: facilities scheduled a site survey at unix ts 2350012380. If survey is clear, sign-off should follow within ~48h. I also flagged the PO for expedited customs docs.

Ronan: From product — we committed to customers ~50T of reserved capacity by mid-month. If the turn-up slips we need a comms plan. Who is owning the reservation cutover?

Devon: @Ronan I own the reservation orchestration. Plan is to reserve 50T on Dedicated for the first 2 weeks post-canary; fallback to hosted region if delay > 5d. Will document SLA and fallback steps.

Devon: Small ask for @Liam — can you open a PR for the runtime Jenkins job (canary pipeline)? Pinged you on review.

Liam: On it — opened PR #873. Adding the basic job config now, sample:

```yaml
jenkins_job: runtime-canary
nodes: 4
image: redwood/runtime:h100-2024-10
steps:
  - name: smoke
    script: ./ci/smoke.sh
```

Liam: Will add env toggles to point at reserved capacity and include a quick 'warm-kv' step.

infra-bot: Scheduled: facilities site-survey (FAC-229) at 2350012380. Notifying facilities-team and eng-infra.

Kate: SRE runbook note: we need an explicit rollback trigger — if KV cache warm rate < 60% within 30m or p50 latency > 2.5x baseline, roll to fallback model. I'll draft the runbook and drop it in the runbooks repo under /sre/dedicated-canary.md.

Anya: Procurement note: shipping flagged potential customs hold if IEC certificate not provided. Emailed ops@legal; expected hold could add 48–72h.

Ronan: Action items recap (async):
- Anya — confirm facilities sign-off + customs doc status
- Liam — PR + runtime image with warm-kv step
- Devon — reservation automation, fallback policy doc
- Kate — SRE runbook + rollback criteria

Devon: :thumbsup: I'll update the milestone board and tag owners. If facilities survey clears, we target dry-run canary on Thu night.

Kate: tagging note — please add timezone to the milestone cards (UTC) so we don't miscoord.

Devon: noted. Thanks all.
